description: Calendar effects of the Russian market: how the index behaved in January, on Mondays, around Bank of Russia meetings, at quarter end and in the tax period. For each effect: the number of observations, the mean and median return, the share of positive outcomes, the t-statistic and the significance after correction for multiple comparisons. Returns are fractions (0.0125 = 1.25 %). This is statistics of the past, not a forecast: an effect marked nominal or none must not be presented as a regularity.

code.description: Code of one effect from the answer, e.g. month_01.

family.description: Effect family: month, weekday, cbr, quarter, tax. Omitted — all.

subject.description: Series: IMOEX (equities) or RGBITR (government bonds). Omitted — both.

name: get_almanac_effect
title: Calendar effects
